msg: Good evening. My daughter (22) wants to do the mini-course and I would just like to come along on the boat, I don't swim well and I won't get in the water. We're Americans staying in the old town. What would each of us pay and what's included for me?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Good evening! The companion plan is perfect if you’d like to ride along without getting in the water. I’m sharing the prices for both plans right below.

For you, the companion plan includes the boat trip between Cartagena and the Rosario Islands, lunch, insurance, and the National Natural Park entrance fee. It doesn’t include diving or snorkeling equipment, since you won’t be going in the water. Ground transportation to the dock isn’t included.

The mini-course includes pool practice, one reef dive with a PADI instructor, equipment, lunch, insurance, and the park entrance fee. You’ll meet at Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m.; the return to Cartagena is estimated for 4:15 p.m. Would you like to know anything else about the day?

🤿 *Dive Mini Course*
💰 *183 USD* per person (online rate)
✅ Includes: National Park entrance fee, mandatory dive insurance, boat transport Cartagena-Islands-Cartagena, pool training + 1 ocean dive with a PADI instructor, diving equipment, lunch and eco-social contribution to DIVE TO HEAL.
📍 Departure from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita, 8:00 a.m.).

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en
---
🤿 *Companion (no diving or snorkeling)*
💰 *80 USD* per person
✅ Includes: boat, lunch, insurance and the National Natural Park entrance fee.
📍 Departure from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita, 8:00 a.m.).

👉 To book this, let me know and I'll connect you with an advisor who arranges the details with you.

msg: Great, thanks. Please connect me with the advisor for my part. My daughter can book her mini-course with the link. Can she pay with her US card, and is the 10% discount included in the 183?
reply:
Yes. International clients pay 100% by card on the website, and with a foreign card the passport is used as the ID document. The 183 USD online price already includes the 10% discount, which is applied automatically when booking directly through our website—not through a third party like PADI.

I'll connect you with an advisor from the Diving Planet team.
They will contact you shortly. Thanks! :)
